name: Dragon Breath
description: Breathes a cone of searing flame dealing 3x ATK damage to all in the area.

name: Death Roll
description: A vicious spinning attack that grapples the target and inflicts bleed for 3 turns.

name: Petrifying Gaze
description: Stares into the target's soul, petrifying them in place for 3 turns.

name: Soul Drain
description: Drains the life force from a target, dealing 2x MATK damage and healing the caster for half.

name: Blood Drain
description: Bites the target, dealing damage and restoring HP equal to the damage dealt.

name: Web Trap
description: Shoots a sticky web that immobilizes the target for 2 turns.
